title: Why Do We Recycle?
hook: Recycling gives used stuff a second job.
narration: Recycling gives used stuff a second job.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do We Recycle.
Less new mining. Less trash in the ground.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Sort paper, plastic, metal, and glass.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Your bin choice is a real planet choice.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Recycling gives used stuff a second job.
The pictures today are a new earth world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do we recycle.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
